judgment.reason: The premises establish a valid logical chain through disjunction elimination and modus ponens. From p23, Ada wears either a teal belt or an ivory coat (or both). In Case A (teal belt), p7 yields: Ada wears a scarlet badge. In Case B (ivory coat), p14 yields: Ada wears a scarlet badge. Thus Ada wears a scarlet badge. Then the chain follows: p24 (scarlet badge → amber pin) → p22 (amber pin → cobalt scarf) → p12 (cobalt scarf → amber badge) → p3 (amber badge → ivory belt). Each step is justified by modus ponens on explicitly stated conditionals. The conclusion that Ada wears an ivory belt follows necessarily from the premises.
